Usage: qr [options] [PAYLOAD]

Cross-platform QR code generator with helpers for Wi-Fi, SMS, mailto, geo, and tel. Default mode encodes a text payload from a positional argument or stdin.

Options:
  --no-margin                   Strip the 4-module quiet zone.
  --force-binary                Allow PNG output to a TTY.
  --force                       Overwrite an existing --output file (refused by default).
  --format FMT                  Output format: auto, unicode, ascii, svg, png. Default auto (unicode on TTY, svg when stdout redirected).
  -s, --size PIXELS             Pixels per module (PNG/SVG only). Default 10.
  -e, --error-correction LEVEL  Error-correction level: l (~7%), m (~15%, default), q (~25%), h (~30%).
  -o, --output PATH             Write to file instead of stdout.
  -h, --help                    Show help
  --version                     Show version
  --color                       Force colored output
  --no-color                    Disable colored output
  --json                        JSON output
  --describe                    Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Subcommands:
  qr wifi   [OPTIONS] --ssid S [--password P] [--security wpa2|wpa|wep|nopass] [--hidden]
  qr sms    [OPTIONS] --number N [--message M]
  qr mailto [OPTIONS] --to A [--subject S] [--body B] [--cc A] [--bcc A]
  qr geo    [OPTIONS] --lat L --lon L [--query Q]
  qr tel    [OPTIONS] --number N

  Run 'qr SUBCOMMAND --help' for subcommand-specific flags.

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  125  Usage error: bad flags, missing required field for a helper subcommand, helper grammar violation (e.g. tel/sms with letters), --format vs --output extension contradiction, refusing to overwrite an existing --output file without --force, PNG to TTY without --force-binary
  126  Runtime error: payload exceeds QR capacity (try --error-correction l), stdin not valid UTF-8, output write failed (parent missing, permission denied, etc.)
